axis: the plain habit of keeping things secret → the whole of it withheld, nothing said at all

members.tone: Names the trait by its outward result — nothing said — where *secrecy* names the keeping back itself.
The flat name for the trait, taking no view on whether what is kept back ought to be.
Informal and clipped where *secrecy* is abstract, shrinking the same trait to one syllable of keeping quiet.
